nodes.description: uint8[] private data: flat pixel color index array indexed by pixelId
uint8[C][] private palette: color palette used by _setColor and getImage
uint256 public immutable auctionEnd: block number at which the auction closes, gates all bid/transfer logic
mapping(uint256=>uint256) private pixelPrice: last paid price per pixel, used to compute the minimum next bid
address immutable devAddress: developer fee recipient set from msg.sender at deploy
bool public auctionStarted: latched on the first buyPixel call, blocks setImage afterwards
uint256 public immutable minInitialBid: minimum price for the first sale of a pixel
uint32 public immutable width: image width used by _getId bounds check
uint32 public immutable height: image height used by _getId bounds check
string private dataURI: base URI overwritten by setDataURI and read by _baseURI
uint256 private _status: ReentrancyGuard lock variable read/written by the nonReentrant modifier
address private _owner: Ownable owner account, checked by onlyOwner
uint256 public immutable auctionStart: block number when the auction opened
buyPixel(uint32 x,uint32 y,uint8 colorIndex) payable isAvailable nonReentrant: bids, pays previous owner and dev, mints or transfers the pixel NFT
changeColor(uint32 x,uint32 y,uint8 colorIndex) isAvailable: recolors a pixel the caller already owns
setImage(ColorMap[] colors) isAvailable onlyOwner: seeds the canvas before the auction starts
getImage(): view helper expanding data into a row-major palette array
getPixelPrice(uint256): view helper returning the current minimum bid
hasEnded(): view helper comparing block.number against auctionEnd
_setColor(uint256 pixelId,uint8 colorIndex) internal: validates colorIndex and writes data[pixelId]
_getId(uint256 x,uint256 y) public view: converts coordinates to a pixelId with bounds checks
_ownerOf(uint256 pixelId) public view: existence-checked wrapper around ERC721 ownerOf
_send(address _to,uint256 _value) internal: forwards ETH with a low-level call{value} to an arbitrary address
safeTransferFrom override: requires hasEnded() before delegating to super.safeTransferFrom
transferFrom override: requires hasEnded() before delegating to super.transferFrom
setDataURI(string) onlyOwner: updates the metadata base URI
PixelArt constructor: initializes ERC721 metadata, palette, auction window, devAddress and data array
getData(): view helper returning the raw data array
getPalette(): view helper returning the palette
_baseURI() override returning dataURI for ERC721Metadata tokenURI
msg.sender: unauthenticated caller used for ownership, payments and minting
Low-level _to.call{value:_value}("") forwards all remaining gas to an arbitrary address before state is finalized
_safeTransfer / _checkOnERC721Received callback into the recipient contract via onERC721Received executed during buyPixel
_safeMint callback into msg.sender via onERC721Received executed during the first-sale branch of buyPixel
pixelPrice[pixelId] * 2: unchecked scaling arithmetic used to derive the minimum next bid
(msg.value * 4) / 5 payout arithmetic splitting bid value between previous owner and dev
uint32 x parameter of buyPixel
uint32 y parameter of buyPixel
uint8 colorIndex parameter of buyPixel passed to _setColor
ColorMap[] memory colors parameter of setImage iterated to seed the canvas
address _to parameter of _send, the arbitrary ETH recipient
uint256 _value parameter of _send, the ETH amount forwarded
pixelId local derived from _getId(x,y) inside buyPixel
currentOwner local returned by ownerOf(pixelId) inside buyPixel
minPrice local = pixelPrice[pixelId] * 2 inside buyPixel
payout local = (msg.value * 4) / 5 sent to the previous owner inside buyPixel

edges.reason: msg.sender determines the caller of buyPixel and receives the minted or transferred NFT without further authorization
changeColor requires _msgSender() == ownerOf(pixelId), so the caller identity gates the color write
setImage is protected by onlyOwner which compares owner() with _msgSender()
devAddress is permanently bound to msg.sender at construction and receives a share of every bid
msg.sender is the recipient of _safeMint, so the receiver callback re-enters attacker-controlled code
buyPixel calls _send to pay the previous owner and the dev before finalizing pixelPrice and color state
_send executes a low-level call{value} forwarding all available gas to the recipient
The external ETH call can re-enter buyPixel before pixelPrice[pixelId] and data[pixelId] are updated
pixelPrice[pixelId] = msg.value is written only after the external value transfer completes
buyPixel writes pixelPrice[pixelId] after performing external calls, violating checks-effects-interactions
buyPixel reads pixelPrice[pixelId] to derive the required minimum bid
pixelPrice[pixelId] is multiplied by 2 inside the price computation
buyPixel computes minPrice = pixelPrice[pixelId] * 2
buyPixel computes payout = (msg.value * 4) / 5 before paying the previous owner
buyPixel calls _safeMint which invokes onERC721Received on msg.sender
buyPixel calls _safeTransfer which invokes onERC721Received on the new owner
The _safeMint receiver callback executes before pixelPrice[pixelId] is assigned
The _safeTransfer receiver callback executes before pixelPrice[pixelId] is assigned
devAddress is used as the recipient argument of _send for the developer fee
buyPixel calls _setColor to persist the winning color
buyPixel calls _getId(x,y) to derive the pixelId
changeColor calls _setColor after the ownership check
changeColor resolves the current owner via ownerOf/_ownerOf
setImage loops over colors and calls _setColor for each entry
setImage requires auctionStarted to be false, preventing canvas edits after bidding opens
buyPixel latches auctionStarted = true on the first purchase, permanently disabling setImage
setDataURI is onlyOwner and writes the dataURI used by _baseURI
_baseURI returns dataURI for ERC721 tokenURI resolution
The isAvailable modifier gates buyPixel on block.number <= auctionEnd, a block-timing dependency
safeTransferFrom is gated on hasEnded() which reads auctionEnd
transferFrom is gated on hasEnded() which reads auctionEnd
hasEnded compares block.number against auctionEnd to decide whether transfers are allowed
The constructor sets auctionEnd = block.number + _auctionDuration, fixing the timing window
The constructor assigns devAddress = msg.sender as the immutable fee recipient
safeTransferFrom calls hasEnded() and reverts while the auction is ongoing
transferFrom calls hasEnded() and reverts while the auction is ongoing
The nonReentrant guard reads and writes _status around buyPixel to block direct re-entry
x parameter controls which pixelId buyPixel operates on
y parameter controls which pixelId buyPixel operates on
colorIndex parameter of buyPixel is forwarded to _setColor
colors array parameter drives every _setColor call in setImage
_to is an arbitrary address supplied by buyPixel and is the target of the low-level call
_value determines the ETH amount forwarded by the low-level call
currentOwner (the previous bidder) is passed as the _to argument of _send
pixelId local indexes the data array written by _setColor
The multiplication pixelPrice[pixelId] * 2 produces the minPrice local
The payout local is the ETH amount forwarded to the previous owner via _send

normalization_plan.reason: x is only used inside buyPixel to derive the pixelId, so it folds into the buyPixel function node
y is only used inside buyPixel to derive the pixelId, so it folds into the buyPixel function node
colorIndex is a buyPixel argument that is immediately forwarded to _setColor, so it folds into buyPixel
the colors array is iterated only inside setImage, so it folds into the setImage function node
_to is the recipient argument of the low-level call, so it folds into _send
_value is the amount argument of the low-level call, so it folds into _send
pixelId is a temporary computed only within buyPixel, so it folds into buyPixel
currentOwner is a temporary resolved and consumed within buyPixel, so it folds into buyPixel
minPrice is produced directly by the price multiplication operation, so it folds into that unsafe operation
payout is produced directly by the (msg.value * 4) / 5 arithmetic operation, so it folds into that unsafe operation
